mentions.name: systemg
mentions.description: A lightweight process supervisor, described as "Systemd, for busy people", that provides what you'd typically want when running and managing production web services, without the many unneeded features baked into systemd.
mentions.problem: The author was tired of getting stuck in config/deployment hell every time they wanted to deploy a long-lived web service, since systemd has many features baked in that they simply don't need.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm personally tired of getting stuck in config/deployment hell every time I want to deploy a long-lived web service. Sure I eventually learned how to use systemd, but systemd has SO many things baked into that I simply don't need. systemg is a lightweight process supervisor that features everything you'd typically want when running/managing production web services in the wild.
